content.what_it_is: MATLAB visualization script for a TMA spectrum stored as component Hmo values: loads SPC_frq/SPC_angle/SPC_HMO from fdir='../TMA/' (L2-L5) and pcolors the raw Hmo matrix @L7. Converts Hmo to energy E=spc.^2/8 @L12 (Etotal variant @L9 uses /8.0 after squaring, Hrms=sqrt(8*Etotal) @L10); computes cell-centered energies Em by 4-point averaging (L18-L26) with densities Dens=Em/dangle/dfre @L22 and bin-center axes F @L23 / A @L24 (dangle in radians @L14, dfre @L15); frequency marginal E_f/D_f (L31-L36) and direction marginal E_a/D_a (L38-L43); Etotal_1=sum(sum(Em)) @L46. Figure 1 (L53-L87): S(f) profile @L56, S(theta) profile @L64, filled contour of density titled 'm^2/Hz/Rad' (L70-L79), and a text panel showing Hrms=sqrt(Etotal_1*8) (L83, L85-L87) with axis off.
entities: script; clear all @L1; variables: fdir @L2; fre @L3; angle @L4; spc @L5; Etotal @L9; Hrms @L10 (reassigned @L83); E @L12; dangle @L14; dfre @L15; n,m @L16; Em @L20; Dens @L22; F @L23; A @L24; E_a @L28; E_f @L29; D_f @L35; D_a @L42; Etotal_1 @L46; d_range @L49; f_range @L50; v @L71

io.name: no file output; figure only (pcolor @L7, subplots L55-L87)

calls: builtins: load, pcolor/shading, sum, sqrt, diff, size, plot, contourf, text, num2str, subplot/axis/grid/title/xlabel/ylabel, clf, axis off @L87
unresolved: Energy normalizations differ: Etotal @L9 divides the squared-Hmo sum by 8 while the componentwise E @L12 also uses /8 — for Hmo per component the usual energy is Hmo^2/16; the script's Hrms values (L10, L83) depend on this convention which is not documented in-file

Dens is indexed (kf,ktheta) @L22 but Em is (ktheta,kf) @L20 — transposed storage; contourf(A,F,Dens,...) @L73 then pairs A (angle centers) with rows kf — consistent only because Dens rows are kf; the pcolor @L7 pairs fre as x with angle as y against spc whose orientation is (n=angles, m=freqs) per L16-L18 loops

E_a/E_f are initialized from dangle/dfre*0.0 (L28-L29) making them one shorter than the axes; D_f/D_a grow implicitly; 'angle' shadows the MATLAB builtin; contour-level vector v @L71 and the commented totalE @L82 are unused
